name: jexpress
description: Orchestrates PDE AI-Work Jira tickets end-to-end (discovery, implementation, review, merge), progressing ticket status automatically and pausing at human review gates until the developer advances it.

ATLASSIAN_EMAIL.title: Atlassian email
ATLASSIAN_EMAIL.description: Email address for Atlassian/Jira API authentication.

PDE_PROJECT_DIR.title: PDE project directory
PDE_PROJECT_DIR.description: Absolute path to the project root that contains tickets/ and the repo clones. The orchestrator and worker read this instead of relying on the invoking shell's working directory, so /jexpress:ticket-orchestrator works regardless of which directory it's run from.
